title: PSX Character Library v1.5: Eight Angles added
bodyHtml:
Eight Angles is in the Library: 14 enemies for 1990s style first person shooters, each as a rigged PSX model and as eight direction billboard sprite sheets, 42 skinned entities, rigged on the same skeleton with the same 45 clips as every other pack here. That makes 19 packs and 265 characters on this page.

If you own the Library, download again at no extra cost. Eight Angles has its own new archive, Retro FPS Enemies (252 MB), so that is the only file you need. The other seven archives changed only in their root files (Readme, catalogue and manifest now list 19 packs); the packs inside them are the same bytes as before.

Changelog, v1.5.0:

  • Added Eight Angles: 14 Retro FPS Enemies as 8 Direction Sprites and PSX Models: Possessed trooper, Frost witch, Mutant brute, Cyborg gunner, Cult acolyte, Ghoul, Shock trooper, Fire fiend, Berserker, Rune knight, Hazmat spitter, Bone shaman, Bronze automaton, Husk marine.
  • New genre archive: Retro FPS Enemies. Every future retro FPS enemies pack joins it.
  • Readme, CATALOGUE and manifest updated to 19 packs and 265 characters.

Eight Angles is also sold on the Hollow Congregation page, together with Hollow Congregation and Saint Oswin: https://csaf.itch.io/hollow-congregation-psx-cultists

How we tested it: every file in the eight archives was read back and checked against the build its own page serves (2999 files). One pack from each archive was extracted and run through our pack gate, and a blank Godot 4.7 project imported all 346 of their GLBs with no errors.

The price: this pack is number 19, which reaches the first step the page has printed since 13 November. The Library stays $19.99 until 7 December 2026, then it is $24.99 for new buyers; a separate post here gives the details. The next step is $29.99 at 22 packs. If you already own it, nothing changes for you.

Free first: one character from every one of these packs is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Count so far: 21 live PSX pages, 7 of them sold, 28 purchases in total.

For anything, post a comment on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

Made with AI tools: the bodies were generated by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.
